variants.precision: fp8 on load (weights bf16 on disk)

steps: Install the author package (github.com/foxl-ai/bobcat @ 43387a09) with vllm==0.30.0 on the author install line.
Download sanghwa-na/bobcat-flash-1.2 @ 58d15456 (bf16 on disk, served FP8).

python -m bobcat.flash_server --engine vllm --model <snapshot> --compiler-model <snapshot>/compiler --quantization fp8 --temperature choice=0.594604,noul=0.353553,score=0.529732 --name bobcat-flash-1.2 --max-num-seqs 64 --max-model-len 98368 --engine-arg max_num_batched_tokens=16384 --engine-arg attention_backend=TRITON_ATTN --identifiers <snapshot>/bobcat-identifiers.json --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --local
Adapter: jevbench typesafe, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8000, model bobcat-flash-1.2.

measured.gpu: NVIDIA H100 80GB (readiness metadata: H100/80GB historical; serve script max-model-len is the BH H100 contingency value)

variants.expected_speed: About 61 ms p 50 per decision on the BH H 100 (raw, serial). Long inputs (61K+ tokens) are slower; see the author README. Provisioning class: H 100 80 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: min_vram_gb left null: no measured minimum in the files read. Not run by this slice. The readiness file records that the BH row still needs a current native admission, and that the per-type temperatures must stay exactly as published. Base google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it @ 4d7ae498 (the two LoRA adapters are merged into these weights). Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 51.612 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 68 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more. VRAM provisioning floor for unchanged BH recipe: H100 80 GB (recorded historical GPU). BF16 shards total 51.612 GB; FP8-on-load is about 25.806 GB before scales/unquantized components. max-model-len 98368, max-num-seqs 64 and max_num_batched_tokens 16384 leave a substantial KV/activation requirement. 80 GB conservatively retains the measured hardware class; a 48 GB short-context recipe was not verified. Exact minimum is not a measured fit threshold.
